newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-FIRST DAY SNIPPETS FROM WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FIRST DAY SNIPPETS FROM WIMBLEDON.

text.p: First day snippets at Wimbledon on Monday:

Quote of the day - "When I won I was almost as happy as when I won the French Open." Iva Majoli after beating Argentina's Mariana Diaz Oliva, ranked 85th in the world. She had never previously won a match at Wimbledon.

Stat of the Day - 41. The number of Wimbledon singles titles shared by former champions Rod Laver, John Newcombe, John McEnroe, Boris Becker, Pete Sampras, Louise Brough, Margaret Court, Billie Jean King, Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova, present at the official opening of the new Number One court.

Jam delays strawberry fans - The All England Club were forced to apologise after many spectators were forced to endure long delays on their way to the grounds. A combination of extra security checks, water-logged car-parks and traffic controls prompted the chaos.

Singing in the rain - A sobering sight greeted those still recovering from Cliff Richard's impromptu sing-song during a centre court rain delay last year. The singer was spotted outside the main gates in the morning, but turned out to be a lookalike performer, hired for the day by a supermarket chain.
Worldwide view - Television coverage of Wimbledon is being beamed to 167 countries. Only 35 of them have a representative in the first round of the men's singles.
